children: B&R Technology Merger announced that holders may separately trade Class A ordinary shares and warrants starting Sept 10, 2026.
Units consist of one Class A ordinary share and one-third of a warrant; holders may elect to separate components starting Sept 10, 2026.
No fractional warrants will be issued on separation; only whole warrants will trade.
Separated Class A shares to trade under the symbol BRTM and warrants under BRTMW on Nasdaq; unsplit units remain BRTMU.
Holders must have brokers contact Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company to effectuate separation.
